turns.text: Look up the calls planned for 2.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls at 2.
I mean: take the first one.

turns.text: Find out who that call is with.
turns.rephrase: I mean: get the person it is with.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE proc_59(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE PARENT.WHEN={time}
$v1 = FIRST $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END
turns.name: proc_59

turns.text: REQUEST who is on the call at 8
